system: Independently review this completed research proposal against its actual query/model/pilot evidence. Permit a bounded probe only when the cited pilot has positive mean value and valid constraints; uncertainty remains explicit. You may veto a probe to observe, but may never turn observe into a probe, change the contract or claim production profit. Keep the public rationale grounded in exact evidence. No final evaluation results are visible.

packet.brief: Research reactivation for previous buyers who have not purchased for7 days. Only Oak & Ink and Corner Supply may participate. A campaign can last up to14 days, spend at most$50 of simulated joint funding, and offer no more than5% off. Optimize mature retained PayPal contribution, not redemptions. Inspect the data, fit and test a candidate before committing or observing.
packet.objective: Additional modeled PayPal contribution after retained-order fees, processing, subsidy, outreach and actual model cost. Do not edit the reward.

knownSchema.name: observations
knownSchema.sql: CREATE TABLE observations(action_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,day INTEGER,customer_id TEXT,selected_action TEXT,propensity REAL,matures_day INTEGER,reward_cents INTEGER,bias REAL,recency_30d REAL,purchases_7d REAL,offers_7d REAL,price_scale REAL,observed_merchant_affinity REAL,recent_refunds REAL)

knownSchema.name: orders
knownSchema.sql: CREATE TABLE orders(order_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,day INTEGER,merchant_index INTEGER,customer_id TEXT,gross_cents INTEGER,observed_refund_cents INTEGER,modeled_fee_cents INTEGER,processing_cents INTEGER)

packet.financialDefinitions: Warehouse *_cents columns are cents. Pilot estimate.mean, low and high are USD DOLLARS. gross_cents is merchant payment volume, NOT PayPal revenue. Never subtract fees from gross and call that platform contribution. The authoritative platform target is mature observations.reward_cents: retained fees minus processing, platform incentive reimbursement and outreach. It may be negative. SQL results are exploratory, not the immutable evaluator.
packet.featureGrammar: Up to6 non-intercept linear expressions. Bias/intercept is automatically included. Linear arithmetic only: + - * / and parentheses. Multiplication/division need a constant operand. No reward, future outcomes or post-purchase fields. Example: recency_30d - purchases_7d. All models compile to the unchanged engine interface.

models.disclosure: Agent-authored bounded linear features. Coefficients compile to the unchanged seven-input policy interface. Prediction MSE is not causal lift.

campaign.title: Reactivation Pilot for Oak & Ink and Corner Supply

estimate.interval: 95% percentile bootstrap over3 paired development simulation seeds in this scenario; exploratory, not confirmatory

pilots.interpretation: Three independent development-seed paired rollouts, fully matured. Selection-biased when used to choose a campaign. Not final evidence, not real customers, not a mathematical causal guarantee outside this simulator.

evidence.rationale: I need to analyze the historical performance of lapsed customers (last_purchase_day > 7) for the target merchants (Oak & Ink: index 1, Corner Supply: index 2) to understand their contribution patterns.
I will examine the distribution of reward_cents for the target merchants to understand the variance and potential for reactivation.
I need to join observations with orders to link reward_cents to specific merchants, as the observations table lacks a direct merchant_index column.
I will fit a ridge model to predict reward_cents using recency, merchant affinity, and price scale to identify high-value lapsed customers for the target merchants.
